title: OPERATOR CARD GETS A CLOSE X AND KEYS
why: Critic 62 and 63: the operator card had no close X and no key hints. Critic 58: the player 2 title carried an amber paragraph. Now a 48px X top right, an Esc Enter strip, and one short player 2 label.
now: The operator card has a close X and a key strip. The player 2 window shows one short line.

edits.anchor: pl.textContent='PLAYER 2. This window links up with the player 1 window on its own. Drag it to your second screen. Your controller works here whether this window is in front or not. World sound plays from the player 1 window; the SOUND row in the PARTY window switches it. MODE: '+netModeName(NET.mode)+'.'; pl.style.display='';
